title: The scheme theoretic image of j = (t, s) for a quasi-compact groupoid scheme over a field carries the restricted groupoid structure

statement_spans.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-quasi-compact-groupoid-on-field-image (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1970-1984

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: The result is a special case of the quasi-compact map version since (U, U times_S U, pr_1, pr_0, pr_02) is a groupoid scheme over S; the author also gives a direct proof. The main difficulty is showing that pr_02 restricted to Z times over pr_1 and pr_0 of Z maps into Z. Writing U = Spec(k), view R, Z and U times_S U as schemes over k via s, pr_1|_Z, pr_1 (giving R_s, Z_s, U^2_s) and via t, pr_0|_Z, pr_0 (giving _tR, _tZ, _tU^2); the morphism j induces morphisms of k-schemes j_s : R_s to U^2_s and _tj : _tR to _tU^2. In the commutative square with top arrow c from R_s times_k _tR to R and left vertical j_s times _tj, the scheme theoretic image of j_s times _tj is Z_s times_k _tZ by the product-map lemma, and commutativity shows Z_s times_k _tZ maps into Z under the bottom horizontal arrow. As in the proof of the perfect-field version, sigma(Z) is contained in Z and the diagonal of U over S factors through Z, and the remaining groupoid axioms follow as in that proof. (source lines 1986-2023)

Write U = Spec(k) and introduce the two families of k-schemes R_s, Z_s, U^2_s (via s, pr_1|_Z, pr_1) and _tR, _tZ, _tU^2 (via t, pr_0|_Z, pr_0), with j inducing j_s : R_s to U^2_s and _tj : _tR to _tU^2 over k; draw the commutative square with top arrow c from R_s times_k _tR to R and left vertical arrow j_s times _tj (proof lines 1996-2012). By varieties-lemma-scheme-theoretic-image-product-map the scheme theoretic image of j_s times _tj is Z_s times_k _tZ; commutativity of the square then shows Z_s times_k _tZ maps into Z under the bottom horizontal arrow (proof lines 2013-2018). As in the proof of lemma-groupoid-on-perfect-field-image, sigma(Z) is contained in Z and the diagonal of U over S factors through Z, and the remaining groupoid axioms for (U, Z, pr_0|_Z, pr_1|_Z, pr_02 restricted) follow as in that proof (proof lines 2018-2022).
proof_roadmap: Note the special-case route through the quasi-compact map version and frame the direct proof around the containment pr_02(Z times_Z) inside Z (proof lines 1986-1995).
Set up the k-scheme notation R_s, Z_s, U^2_s, _tR, _tZ, _tU^2 and the commutative square for the composition map (proof lines 1996-2012).
Compute the scheme theoretic image of j_s times _tj as Z_s times_k _tZ via the product-map lemma and derive the containment in Z from commutativity (proof lines 2013-2018).
Finish by the perfect-field template: sigma-invariance, diagonal factorization, and the remaining groupoid axioms as in the cited proof (proof lines 2018-2022).
